sleep.disclaimer: Wellness indicators based on oxygenation and pulse rate. They are not a medical assessment: for any finding worth looking into, consult your doctor.
sleep.spo2ChartHint: Mean per minute; red band below 90 %; red dots at the event nadirs.
sleep.cyclicNote: The cyclic pattern (at least 3 consecutive drops 20-100 s apart with similar amplitude) is a proxy for periodic breathing: it is reported, not interpreted.

sleep.prChartHint: Mean per minute; green line = basal pulse; yellow dots = events with surge ≥ 6 bpm.
sleep.surgeNote: The surge (pulse rising after the nadir of a desaturation) is a proxy for a micro-awakening: without EEG, true awakenings are not counted.
